title: Solve configuration, version 1
description: Explicit solve configuration under SPEC-0002. Every limit and tolerance is caller-supplied; there are deliberately no defaults, so a record always states what was run.

seed.description: Deterministic seed recorded and passed to the backend.

time_limit_ms.description: Wall-clock limit in milliseconds, or null for unlimited.

iteration_limit.description: Simplex or interior-point iteration limit, or null.

tolerances.description: Original-model validation policy applied to extracted candidates.

threads.description: Native worker threads. Only one CPU thread is supported.
